read_project_file(file="artifacts/expert_trajectory_plan.md", project="cost-verify-agent-rl", max_chars=0)

```bash

export ALFWORLD_DATA=/root/autodl-tmp/alfworld

   - 查看如何创建和使用 expert agent：

echo $!
```

```bash
sleep 30 && head -50 /root/autodl-tmp/logs/expert_collection.log
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/expert_trajectories/ 2>/dev/null | head -10
```
